<VirtualHost *:8080>
  ServerName localhost
  ProxyPreserveHost On
  ProxyRequests Off

  # MapServer WMS raster OWS (CGI)
  ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver
  Alias /xplan-mapserver /opt/mapserver/run/mapserv-wrapper
  <Files "mapserv-wrapper">
    SetHandler cgi-script
    Require all granted
  </Files>

  # Dienste-Tomcat
  ProxyPass /xplan-services-wms/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wms/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-services-wms/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wms/
  ProxyPass /xplan-services-wfs-syn/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wfs-syn/
  ProxyPassReverse /xplan-services-wfs-syn/ http://127.0.0.1:18080/xplan-services-wfs-syn/
  ProxyPass /xplan-services-wfs/ http://127.
The Apache error log may have more information.
mapserver via apache: 404

python3 - <<'PY'
p="/etc/apache2/sites-enabled/xplanbox.conf"
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace(
'''  # MapServer WMS raster OWS (CGI)
  Alias /xplan-mapserver /opt/mapserver/run/mapserv-wrapper''',
'''  # MapServer WMS raster OWS (CGI)
  ProxyPass !/xplan-mapserver
  Alias /xplan-mapserver /opt/mapserver/run/mapserv-wrapper''')
open(p,"w").write(s)
print(s[:700])
PY
apache2ctl configtest 2>&1 | tail -1 && apache2ctl -k restart 2>&1 | tail -1
sleep 3
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "mapserver via apache: %{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:8080/xplan-mapserver?request=GetCapabilities&service=WMS&version=1.1.1"
